title: Design a monorepo pipeline reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for design a monorepo pipeline should include: paths:, needs:, shared.
answer.example:
name: Web component checks
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "web/**"
      - "shared/**"
      - "package-lock.json"
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  web-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo "Run web tests"
answer.verification: The workflow reacts to changes in web code and its listed shared dependencies; update filters when dependency relationships change.
